data.one_liner: High-performance Dart image manipulation backed by Rust FFI for resizing, cropping, and encoding.
data.what_it_does: Provides cross-platform image manipulation like resizing, cropping, rotating, and filtering by running operations through a Rust FFI backend. Uses lazy pipelines to execute multiple operations in a single native call.
use_when: You need high-performance image resizing, cropping, or encoding in Dart or Flutter
You want to process images using lazy, chainable pipelines
You need support for multiple platforms including mobile, desktop, and web via WebAssembly
avoid_when: You want pure Dart implementations without native binaries or Rust toolchain dependencies
You only need high-level UI image loading and caching from network URLs
strengths: Extremely fast image processing powered by Rust and SIMD
Lazy pipelines run all operations in a single native call
Cross-platform support across mobile, desktop, and web
weaknesses: Requires managing native binaries or setting up a Rust toolchain for custom formats
Manual memory disposal is required for loaded native image handles
data.setup_notes: Native binaries are downloaded automatically via Dart build hooks. WebAssembly builds require placing pixer.wasm in the web root.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart alternative for decoding, manipulating, and encoding images without relying on native FFI or Rust binaries.
